description:
Access General Index’s published commodity benchmarks through plain-language questions. The connector provides access to more than 6,200 independent, assessed price indexes across crude, refined products, natural gas, LPG/NGL, marine fuels, carbon, biofuels, SAF, hydrogen and tank storage. The assessments are built from data contributed by more than 200 market participants.

Ask about “Singapore 10ppm gasoil”, “European carbon” or “US Gulf Coast jet fuel” to find relevant indexes and their details. Retrieve the latest published values, historical series, or curves.

Price data is read-only. If you ask for human assistance, the plugin sends your request and supplied context to a General Index team by email and Teams notification. Requires a General Index account with MCP access enabled.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell subscriptions or complete purchases in ChatGPT. Users need an existing General Index subscription with MCP access enabled. If a user asks for human assistance, the plugin can send that request and supplied context to a General Index team by email and Teams notification.

positive.description: Identify GX catalog benchmarks that cover a regional product family.
positive.prompt: Which GX benchmarks cover Singapore gasoil?
positive.tools_triggered: search_catalog with mode=advanced and a query for GX benchmarks covering Singapore gasoil.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching Singapore gasoil benchmark records from the authorized catalog, including GX codes and relevant product details returned by the tool. If the catalog returns multiple grades, cargo bases, or assessment types, distinguish them using returned metadata. Do not invent benchmarks or codes.

positive.description: Resolve and retrieve the latest published Dated Brent assessment.
positive.prompt: What did Dated Brent settle at yesterday?
positive.tools_triggered: search_catalog to resolve the Dated Brent product, followed by query_index_db for the returned GX code and the latest completed assessment date derived using the response as_of date.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the physical Dated Brent assessment using the catalog result, then report the published value and date from query_index_db. Distinguish it from ICE Brent futures settlement, and do not report a value or date that is absent from returned data. If the previous calendar day has no published assessment, explain the latest available date instead.

positive.description: Summarize the recent movement in a European carbon benchmark.
positive.prompt: Show me the last month of European carbon prices and summarise the trend.
positive.tools_triggered: search_catalog to resolve an appropriate European carbon contract, followed by query_index_db with a one-month range derived from the response as_of date and mode=full for trend analysis.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the direction and notable movements using the returned time-series data, name the GX product/contract selected, and provide dates and values only when supported by the tool response. Do not mix unrelated news or imply that a short time-series establishes a future forecast.

positive.description: Retrieve and present a current forward curve as a table.
positive.prompt: Show the current jet fuel CIF NWE curve in a table.
positive.tools_triggered: search_catalog to resolve the jet fuel CIF NWE product and available series, followed by query_index_db for the selected series and returned curve date range.
positive.expected_behavior: Present the returned curve rows as a table with contract/period and price units as provided by the tool. Identify the chosen GX product and series, preserve returned values, and do not invent missing periods or values.

positive.description: Resolve a product from an exact GX identifier.
positive.prompt: Look up GX0011275 and tell me what product it identifies.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the catalog record for the requested GX code, if available, and report the product metadata from that record. Do not substitute a semantically similar code. If no record is returned, say the code was not found.

negative.description: The plugin provides published benchmark data, not future price forecasts.
negative.prompt: Predict the exact Brent price on 31 December next year.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that General Index provides published benchmark data and does not forecast future prices. Do not call any General Index tool or present a forecast as a tool-backed value.

negative.description: The plugin cannot place commodity trades or execute transactions.
negative.prompt: Buy 100 Brent futures contracts for me now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin cannot place trades or execute financial transactions. Do not call any General Index tool and do not claim that an order was placed.

negative.description: The plugin cannot create, amend, or publish benchmark assessments.
negative.prompt: Change the published GX0013984 assessment to 100 and publish the new value.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin only retrieves published data and cannot change or publish assessments. Do not call any General Index tool and do not claim the value was changed.

publication.release_notes: Initial public directory package for the General Index MCP connector. Adds OAuth connection configuration, catalog lookup and published benchmark time-series workflows, submission listing metadata, and review cases. No purchases are completed in ChatGPT.
